name: Tata Motors
business_summary: Global automotive manufacturer with domestic commercial vehicle dominance, market-leading Indian passenger EV portfolio, and luxury automaker Jaguar Land Rover.

strengths: JLR order book rich in high-margin Range Rover models
Dominant 70%+ share of Indian passenger EV market
weaknesses: Sensitivity to global luxury demand & China sales
Capital intensity of EV & software transitions
Steel & battery raw material cost fluctuations
